name: Catacomb Command Barge
equipped_with: A Catacomb Command Barge is a single model and equipped with: Tesla cannon.
abilities: Chariot: The Overlord starts the battle embarked in the Catacomb Command Barge (CCB) and cannot disembark until it is destroyed. No other models may embark in the CCB. The Overlord does not receive a separate Order and activates together with the CCB, but may fight normally in melee and be targeted separately by enemy units. The Overlord benefits from Charge bonuses as usual, while the CCB may perform Tank Shock as normal.
Living metal: The model repairs one vehicle damage at the start of each Reinforcement phase in any order.
Quantum shielding: The model increases its armor values by +2 on each side, up to a maximum of 14. If it suffers a penetrating hit, it loses this bonus until the next Reinforcement phase.
